notes.title: Update 1.0.2 - EstradaBus HD Demo
EstradaBus HD Demo - Update 1.0.1
ESTRADABUS HD DEMO NOW AVAILABLE
notes.content:
Hey guys!

With great happiness, we announce the launch of the EstradaBus HD Demo!

In this demo, the basic game content are available:

[list]
[*] Two buses
[*] Vehicle traffic system
[*] Four destinations and up to twelve different jobs possible on the map
[*] Menu with options for video settings during the pause menu
[*] In-game navigation minimap
[/list]


Soon, new demonstration updates will be released, until the launch of EstradaBus HD in advance access, where you will be able to manage your company, transport passengers and earn rewards for that, in order to be able to buy garages, buses for your garages, fill your buses tanks and upgrade your company!

Thank you for all the support and support!

Please, any questions, suggestions or reports, please contact us:

A big hug and good trips!
